body_ar: إن المحن والبلايا من سنن الله في خلقه، فمن وقعت له محنة فليرض بمقدور الله، وليصبر على ما أصابه، فإن عقبى الصابرين حميدة، ولا شك أن الصبر يتحقق بأمور يتعلمها المرء ويتذكرها، وقد أرشد إليها القرآن والسنة، فعلى المسلم تعلمها والتحلي بها. منزلة الصبر بين صفات أهل الإيمان: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه، واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، تبرأت من حولي وقوتي واعتصمت بحول الله وقوته. موضوع هذا الدرس: الصبر في الابتلاء والمحن. إن الله سبحانه وتعالى سلط على المؤمنين بعض البلايا والمحن، وآتاهم معها جنداً عظيماً من جنوده، هو الصبر، وقواهم به عليها، وهذا الصبر مزية عظيمة ومنزلة رفيعة ..
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* Afflictions and trials are among God's established ways with His creation. Whoever is struck by an affliction, let him be content with what God has decreed and be patient with what has befallen him, for the outcome of the patient is praiseworthy. There is no doubt that patience is realised through matters a person learns and calls to mind, to which the Qur'an and the Sunnah have directed; so a Muslim must learn them and adorn himself with them.

## The rank of patience among the qualities of the people of faith

In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving. Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. I ask God's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the Day of Judgement. I disclaim my own power and my own strength, and take hold of God's power and God's strength.

The subject of this lesson is: patience in trial and affliction. God, glorified and exalted is He, has set upon the believers certain trials and afflictions, and has given them, together with these, a mighty soldier from among His soldiers — namely patience — and has strengthened them by it against them. This patience is a great distinction and a lofty rank ..

translator_notes: One of a run of thirteen records, IDs 688-700, all uploaded on 5 and 8-9 May 2011 within a few hours of one another, all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/c-a-* series. The uniform timestamps are a bulk upload and say nothing about when the lessons were delivered.

The record contains two distinct voices and the English keeps them apart. The opening paragraph is a synopsis written by the site, about the lesson and in the third person; everything from the section heading onward is the Sheikh's own words as transcribed. Nothing in the synopsis may be quoted as his.
'سنن الله في خلقه' is rendered 'God's established ways with His creation' — the regularities He has set in the world — and not 'the sunnah', which in English would suggest prophetic practice.
No ruling term appears anywhere in the record.
